hook.name: Pangea Fee Hook V2
hook.description: Pangea launch-pool fee hook with a changeable fee. Takes the trading fee (0.3%-5%) in the quote asset on every swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas and credits it as ERC-6909 claims to the pool's fee splitter. The pool's payee or the platform admin can change the fee within 0.3%-5% (one change per pool per block; fees earned at the old rate are settled first). Liquidity adds are locker-only, swaps past the launch range edge revert, and Pangea's launch buyers pay no fee.
